newsitem.title: USA: Goldman says Q3 pre-tax profit up vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Goldman says Q3 pre-tax profit up vs year ago.

text.p: Goldman Sachs & Co, Wall Street's largest private partnership, said pre-tax profit in the third quarter, ended in August, rose to $589 million versus $425 million a year ago.
Revenues grew to $1.468 billion versus $1.189 billion a year ago.
Goldman said Chief Financial Officer John Thain disclosed the results to the firm's 173 partners at a meeting on Monday.

For the nine months, ended August 30, the firm recorded pre-tax profit $1.863 billion on revenues of $4.602 billion. Goldman said the nine month profit figure topped the entire pre-tax profit in 1995 of $1.369 billion.
